reviews.title: Pages render instantly.
reviews.comment: Happy - not used for gaming - but on a four-display monster desktop. Good improvement over the old 10-year-old GPU. Pages render (open) instantly - 2D CAD work mostly. Some minor 3D rendering - all works as expected.  Good upgrade for me, and it benchmarks well with other GPUs - had to have the four DisplayPort, and at a price point I was comfortable with -- fair price.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Effective Linux Multi Monitor Solution
reviews.comment: Running Ubuntu variant driving three ultra fine monitors effortlessly. Plug and play. Four months straight and not even a hiccup on X11. Yet to try Wayland. Fully configurable in KDE Plasma 5. Strong recommend for this use case.
reviews.author: S. Shelton
